provenance.capture: Official-site Playwright Chromium full-page capture at the recorded viewports. Scrolled in 80 percent viewport increments to trigger lazy content, waited, and returned to top. No page content or styling was altered.
provenance.diagnostics: Observed dark hero and booking panel, circular price/service menu, craft story cards, chair-side process strip, interior gallery. The mobile capture was taken at 390 px. Source-specific omissions and non-transferable claims are noted in the prompt.
provenance.attribution: Baba Barbers craft and booking official website. The requester attested to screenshot and prompt clearance; no source-owner grant was uploaded.

referenceDna.annotatedDescription: A deep teal barber-shop photograph supports a left promise while a small booking panel floats on the right; restrained gold points add depth. A slim warm-accent utility strip and compact service, story, gallery and booking links sit above the opening. Large italic or calligraphic serif chapter titles, small uppercase labels and compact practical service copy. The page sequence runs from dark hero and booking panel to circular price/service menu to craft story cards toward booking band, local visit details, dense dark footer. Salon atmosphere, craft archive, hands-at-work strips and haircut results appear in separate chapter-sized groups. Only transferable composition, hierarchy and service-routing mechanics are retained.
